title: Mercury
summary: Reads the balance of every Mercury account from api.mercury.com, once an hour or as often as its setting says, into Money's accounts, and its last thirty days of transactions into the ledger.
changes: Mercury under its own id, one a record, in place of mercury-company. The key's label and how often it asks are settings on this pack's page, so nothing is filled in before it is installed.
author: BrainDog

grant.label: Key
grant.note: The label of the key in the vault that the balances pull and the ledger both send as a bearer token. A label and never the key itself: an add-on that carries a key is refused.

every.label: How often
every.note: How often it asks Mercury for balances and transactions. Mercury allows 100 requests a minute, so once an hour is far inside it.

book.label: Book
book.note: The number of the book in Books that every Mercury account and transaction is filed in: 2 for books#2. Leave it at 0 to file none.

declarations.title: Mercury transactions
